# dsh-advanced-model-editor

A DeepSeek Harness WebUI plugin that adds an **Advanced Model Configuration** section to the
Setting

s page. It manages LLM provider profiles across the settings namespaces — the
custom provider namesp

ace (`llm-pi-ai`) and the official provider namespace
(`llm-deepseek`) — including built-in and cust

om providers, model lists,
reasoning/thinking options, headers, retry policy and more, with the same

validation
and conflict rules as the official settings UI.

Reads and writes ride DSH's shared settings services (`ctx.configForms` /
`ctx.settingsSchema`), so

this page and the official Models page share one document
mirror and one revision queue instead of r

acing each other. The section appears only
while one of its namespaces is actually served, and it sh

ows the provider facts DSH
directory reports — the endpoint a profile inherits (`defaultBaseURL` / `

baseURLEnv`),
the route's own authentication (`nativeAuth`, including OAuth) and any catalog
diagnos
tic — so a keyless route no longer reads as a missing credential.

The official DeepSeek card also shows how its catalog relates to the service's
model listing: whethe

r the route still follows `GET /models`, whether an edited
catalog replaced it, or whether the endpo

int is not the official one at all — with
a **Restore defaults** action that clears the override and
resumes the listing.
## Requirements

- **DSH** `>= 0.2.2-rc.1` — only the current release is supported. There is no
backward-compatibilit

y layer for older DSH versions.
- **Node.js** `^22.19 || >=24`.

` forwards to pnpm internally.

## Development & Maintenance Commands

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `pnpm run build` | Full build (runs `tsc` type check + g

enerates `lib/` bundles) |
| `pnpm run check` | Type check only (`tsc --noEmit`) without emitting fi

les |
| `pnpm test` | Full build, then run the test suite (`node --test`) |
| `pnpm run lint` | ESLi

nt, type check, test suite, and Prettier check in one pass (CI gate) |
| `pnpm run lint:fix` | Apply

ESLint fixes, then rewrite the files with Prettier |
| `pnpm run fmt` | Format source and config fi

les with Prettier |
| `pnpm run fmt:check` | Check code formatting compliance |
